---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a bounded improvement with a verification path
title: "[Feature] "
---

## Problem

What real workflow is difficult today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the language, runtime, tooling or website behavior without assuming an
implementation.

## Evidence and trade-offs

Which design document, example, test or existing surface should guide this?
What should remain explicitly out of scope?

## Validation

Describe the positive and negative examples that would prove the proposal.
